description:
"I will be a loyal lover to my lady."

After losing her husband, Ophelia lives alone—
until Rodion, the heir to a ducal house, appears before her,
asking to serve as her attending knight.

"Please… play with me."

A man of noble birth, six years her junior,
seeks a role that’s closer to a lover than a servant—
and Ophelia can’t help but question his true intentions.

"I’ll make sure you can never send me away."

But Rodion only presses closer,
determined to make himself irreplaceable.

“My god… how is it that big?”

In both looks and form, he’s flawless.
A fiery romance blooms between the elegant noblewoman
and her all-too-perfect knight—
a love unlike any she’s ever known.
